propositions: Authors lack a concise, discoverable on-ramp for writing plans that pass the plan-review gate; existing material is either gate mechanics or a generated criterion registry, creating a discoverability gap.
The same on-ramp discoverability gap exists for the code-review gate (LLM-Review + Verified); AGENTS.md currently mispoints authors at the criterion registry instead of author-focused guidance.

The CLI rebar explain command and MCP explain_criterion tool must be extended to serve author guides (rebar explain plan, rebar explain review) via the shared registry lookup, while keeping the registry as the single source of truth for reviewers.
New hand-written prose on-ramp docs must be linked from docs/README.md to satisfy the docs-index CI gate and remain discoverable; the generated criterion registry must stay separate and unchanged.
